messages:
Maya H: Follow-up from last week's outage (cloud auth throttles + model-registry lag). I sketched remediation actions + who can own them. Need timelines and any blockers.
Diego R: Drop the list here pls.
Maya H: Actions: 1) auth-provider fanout + short-lived cache -> owner Diego, 2) registry failover drills + point-in-time restore test -> owner Sven, 3) onboarding smoke-tests (no heavy downloads) -> owner Priya, 4) postmortem update: add dependency patterns & heatmap -> owner Maya.
Diego R: I can take #1. Plan: per-provider circuit breakers, cache TTL 30s to start, PoC 2026-04-07, staging 2026-04-16. Will need security review for token storage.
Sven K: Taking #2. I'll coordinate with infra for a controlled failover drill on 2026-04-09 and follow-up automation by 2026-04-22.
Priya V: Taking #3. Will add a webhook-based regression check to registry CI by 2026-04-06. It will validate metadata + small sample artifact.
Maya H: I'll add the postmortem heatmap and call out recurring patterns (auth spike during bulk uploads, registry GC stalls). Draft due 2026-04-03.
incident-bot: Reminder: create board tasks and attach 1-paragraph test plans. Link: https://redwood.internal/boards/vendor-mitigations
Diego R: Q: for cache eviction on rotate events, should we subscribe to key-rotation webhook?
Priya V: Yes, subscribe and invalidate cache immediately.
Sven K: For the drill, I'll include both read-only failover and promotion scenarios.
Maya H: Proposed weekly 20-min 'deps resilience' check until tasks closed. Wednesdays 9am PT. Can everyone make it?
Diego R: Works.
Sven K: Works.
Priya V: Works.
Maya H: Calendar sent. Owners: please add test plans to the board by EOD Friday. Flag blockers here so we can escalate.
Diego R: Will add test plan + ping security.
Sven K: Adding drill playbook now.
Priya V: Adding smoke-test steps.
incident-bot: Actions created: #5101 auth-fanout (owner: Diego R), #5102 registry-drill (owner: Sven K), #5103 onboarding-smoke (owner: Priya V), #5104 deps-postmortem-update (owner: Maya H). Weekly reminders enabled.
Maya H: Thanks all — will post measured latencies after the first drill and update the heatmap. :white_check_mark:
